units.source_text: 那位出家为尼的藤壶皇后，虽然深恐世人说长道短，

en.t: Empress Fujitsubo, who had taken vows and become a nun, deeply feared the gossip of the world,

units.source_text: 于己身不利，因而万事谨慎小心，

en.t: and worried that it would bring harm upon herself, so she was cautious and careful in all things,

units.source_text: 但也常常偷偷地寄信与源氏公子。

en.t: yet she also often sent letters secretly to Prince Genji.

units.source_text: 源氏公子回想：“她往日若能如此相思，如此多情，我何等欢喜！”

en.t: Prince Genji thought back, If only she had longed for me like this in the past, with such tenderness, how happy I would have been!

units.source_text: 又怨恨地想：“我为她受尽煎熬，都是前生孽缘！”

en.t: Then he thought bitterly, I have suffered every torment for her; it must all be an ill-fated bond from a former life!
